description: Use this when the user asks what needs attention: overdue invoices, bills to pay, the next VAT return and its deadline, or tax warnings ("what's due this week?"). What needs paying or filing: overdue sales invoices (remaining above 0 and past the due date), unpaid supplier bills due within days (default 14, overdue bills included; needs access to bills), the next VAT return not yet marked filed, past VAT periods not marked filed, each with its filing deadline (period end + 28 days, moved to the next UAE working day), vat_estimate (the VAT report's net so far for the next return: an estimate from the documents in Fatura Go, not a figure to file) and warnings (at most two, ranked; any penalty comes with its official source and checked date, so keep those with the amount). When warnings_check is "unavailable", warnings and more_warnings are null and vat_estimate is null: that part could not be checked, which does not mean there is nothing to report. Each list has count (the full total), listed and has_more: when has_more is true, say how many there are and do not present the list as complete. Do not use it for the full list of supplier bills (list_bills_due) or for VAT figures by box (get_vat_return_boxes).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

days.description: Bills due within this many days from today, 0 to 60. Default 14.
